rule: A collection is listed only when Jim approves it, and only on facts anyone can check: (a) the art link in the collection's token metadata no longer serves the art, or (b) the creator's wallet and channels have been silent for 12 months or more. The machine never calls a listed project a scam; on the machine every listed collection is 'Rescued'.
how_to_add: Add an entry with approved:false, its evidence (contract reads, URLs, dates) and the reason code. Jim flips approved to true. Then run: python3 tools/fetch-art.py && node tools/make-art.mjs && node tools/build.mjs. An approved entry with no helper shows desaturated with NOT YET FOREVER and counts towards STILL AT RISK.

Forever Twins registry (xtrata.xyz/forever-twins/data/registry.v2.json, bitcoin-birds.info.about): 'that link (stacksart.com/assets/birds.json) now returns an ordinary web page, not token data. The pictures themselves are kept in a single IPFS folder ... Nothing on the chain names that folder.'

The build host could not reach stacksart.com itself (blocked by its network), so the 'returns a web page' observation is the registry's, recorded as such in art/sources.json.
